claims.boundary: Only the exact finite ISO C90 execution with virtual endpoints 30 and 15; no physical backward signalling.
claims.statement: The strict C90 witness executes a byte-exact 257-byte request from virtual address 30 to 15 and a deterministic 258-byte response from 15 to 30 while host events increase from 1 through 9.

claims.boundary: Finite boundary evidence for the listed lengths through 4096 bytes; not a universal execution proof.
claims.statement: The witness passes both directions for payload lengths 0, 1, 16, 17, 18, 31, 255, 256, 257 and 4096 and rejects an intentionally missing chunk.

claims.boundary: Conditional paper proof under append-only source, branch-only replay and absence of mutating side paths; fresh Lean transfer is pending.
claims.statement: Append-only source history combined with branch-only replay preserves every existing source prefix.

claims.boundary: Conditional paper proof for the monotone host semantics defined in the manuscript; it excludes rather than establishes physical backward effects.
claims.statement: Under monotone host semantics every generated effect occurs at a larger host index than its send event even when the virtual target address is smaller.

claims.boundary: For each individual finite bit string under integrity, eventual delivery, a complete manifest and sufficient finite resources; fresh Lean transfer is pending.
claims.statement: Every individual finite bit string can be transported losslessly by finite segmentation, manifest validation and ordered reassembly under the stated delivery and resource assumptions.

claims.boundary: Conditional on VTI-005 in each direction, terminating replay and response, distinct identities and complete gates; virtual bidirectionality only.
claims.statement: Two finite virtual channels plus a terminating response function compose into a bidirectional virtual dialogue while all generating host events remain forward ordered.

claims.boundary: Source attribution to the exact prior finite CTM receipt; it is not a fresh kernel proof of VTI-003 through VTI-009.
claims.statement: The prior Canonical Temporal Memory receipt records nine Lean-kernel-verified theorems concerning release gates, counterfactual future relevance, source non-overwrite, identifier binding and reciprocal closure in its finite model.

claims.boundary: Conditional paper proof whose complete-mediation premise is a deployment obligation; a bypass violates the premise.
claims.statement: If every executor path is completely mediated and ordinary release requires a valid EFFECT_ACK_DONE record, no non-DONE record can trigger ordinary release.

claims.boundary: Conditional systems statement under an explicit failure model; EFFECT_ACK alone does not establish exactly-once.
claims.statement: Exactly-once requires atomic deduplication and effect coupling or an idempotent executor, plus eventual delivery and availability; EFFECT_ACK by itself is insufficient.

claims.boundary: A methodological declaration; particular applications must specify decoder, context, validity and authorization contracts.
claims.statement: Byte identity, semantic identity, truth and authorized real-world effect shall be treated as separate verification obligations.

claims.boundary: Scope-bound novelty candidate based on the targeted comparison in the manuscript; no world-priority, patent or exhaustive-review claim.
claims.statement: Whether the full conjunction of immutable source history, past-targeted branch replay, three orders, bidirectional session correlation and fail-closed effect authorization is globally novel remains under independent review.

claims.boundary: No operative mapping from a virtual address to an earlier spacetime event is implemented or evidenced here.
claims.statement: A bridge from virtual-time addressing to physical future-to-past signalling is an additional unverified natural hypothesis.

claims.boundary: Requires preregistration, a later randomized intervention, an earlier sealed measurement, leak controls, quantitative error control and independent replication.
claims.statement: Positive controllable backward physical channel capacity in either direction remains experimentally unestablished by this work.
